title: AuthZ Bridge: Orchestrated backfill, audit streaming and admin comms for RBAC v2 cutover
creator: Aisha Patel
description: High-level orchestration and runbook for migrating customers from RBAC v1 to RBAC v2. This ticket owns the end-to-end plan for backfilling missing role assignments, running dual-write validation, streaming audit logs to the new audit pipeline, verifying SAML/SSO role mappings, and communicating admin-facing changes. The goal is a controlled, observable cutover with safe fallbacks and clear customer comms templates.
acceptance_criteria: Dual-write enabled for >99% write paths with <1% error delta compared to v1 during synthetic traffic
Backfill job completes for production orgs within expected window and reports 0 data integrity failures after reconciliation
Audit streaming validated: every change to role grants/revokes appears in new audit pipeline within 30s and matches v1 historical logs for sampled orgs
SAML/SSO mapping verification harness confirms nameID->role mapping parity for 95% of active customers; mismatch list produced and owner assigned
Admin console shows clear migration status per org; can toggle safe-mode to force v1 behavior for troubleshooting
Customer comms templates reviewed and legal-approved; sent to customers in phased waves with opt-out/runbook for high-risk tenants
implementation_steps: Instrument and test dual-write layer: enable feature flag dualwrite/authz-v2-shadow; add metric points for success/error counts
Build backfill orchestration: chunked, idempotent backfill job w/ checkpoints and tombstone handling; preserve historical grant timestamps
Audit streaming: add change capture hook to publish role-change events to audit-kafka topic and backfill historical deltas via audit-replay job
SSO/SAML mapping: add normalized mapping table; run mapping-export for customers with custom attribute mappings; create fallback heuristics for edge cases
Admin controls: implement "admin-safe-mode" toggle and a per-org migration-status page in Console with recent reconciliation results
Validation harness: synthetic traffic generator, invariant checks (role-counts, manager->reporting checks), and sampling comparison job between v1/v2 stores
Create runbooks: step-by-step cutover, canary validation checklist, escalation contacts, and rollback commands
QA & Security review: pair with Security for threat model update and ensure KMS keys used for audit pipeline are logged
rollout_steps: Phase 0 (Dry run): Run backfill and audit-replay against staging with synthetic orgs; exercise reconciliation and failure paths
Phase 1 (Canary): Select 10 low-risk production orgs; enable dual-write shadow for reads/writes; observe metrics for 72 hours
Phase 2 (Expanded Wave): Add 100 medium-risk orgs, limit backfill concurrency to reduce DB IO; run SAML mapping validation and notify customers with mismatches
Phase 3 (Bulk roll): Gradually increase to 80% orgs over 7 days with automated health gates; enable admin-safe-mode in few orgs to validate toggling
Phase 4 (Cutover): On success of health gates, flip routing to authoritative v2 for control-plane reads; keep dual-write for 48h for safety
Phase 5 (Post-cutover verification): Run full reconciliation pass; close out remaining backfill jobs and archive migration artifacts
monitoring_and_alerts: Audit lag: audit.pipeline.latency >30s -> page on-call infra/security
SAML mismatch rate >2% for new orgs -> throttle rollout and open tickets for engineering/SE to contact customer
Console health gates: failed reconciliation count per org >0 triggers review and potential rollback
rollback_plan: Flip routing back to authoritative v1 reads (console toggle) — immediate fallback to read-v1 mode
Disable dual-write to prevent further divergence and pause backfill jobs
Run targeted reconciliation to identify root cause and create hotfix patch
Communicate incident to affected customers with timeline and mitigation steps
If necessary, run data recovery playbook from pre-migration snapshots (only after lead approval)
communication_plan: Pre-cutover: 30-day notice with detailed migration FAQ and SSO mapping checklist. Include 'how to request migration deferral' instructions
Canary notice: direct message to selected canary org admins explaining scope and expected behavior
Cutover-day: 24-hour reminder and point-of-contact; post-cutover verification email with link to migration dashboard
Template: Admin comm w/ sample SAML attribute mapping, screenshots of Console migration-status, rollback instructions, and support links
Post-migration: summary report to customers showing reconciliation results and audit link to role-change events
